subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about completed bookings for {Brand}. Since Skyscanner launched its flight app inside ChatGPT for UK travellers and its CEO is pushing agentic booking, intent is shifting toward conversational entry, and travel acquisition costs are climbing, search CPAs near 49 dollars and display near 113 dollars. That is the spread where reading to the confirmed booking and proving incrementality decide your real cost per ticket. We hold out a control group so paid bookings show as incremental to organic comparison traffic. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely Skyscanner ChatGPT/agentic-booking shift (sourced) + travel CPA band
